content.text: Skip to content Newsletter Discover Your Persona 77°F 0 Saved Welcome to the City of Champions April 23-25, 2026 A city where mighty bridges stand for strength, progress and innovation. Where three rivers meet in a golden triangle forging a proud legacy of tenacity, grit and determination. Powered by heart and soul, Pittsburgh is a place where football is not just a sport, it’s a way of life. Here, the journey to legend begins.
